welcome.title: Near misses
welcome.text: Windows will appear in front of you. Do what each one asks, as you would on a real one: they don't move or click, the cameras record your hands.|Press the button on the right side of the headset to start each step. Pressed while recording, it pauses.

done.title: All done
done.text: Thank you! This recording session will close. Continue in the application.|Review your recordings in the Hand recorder window.

stopped.title: Stopped
stopped.text: What was recorded so far is saved. Review it in the Hand recorder window.

sections.title: Hand size
sections.intro: First, your hand size: both hands up about 40 cm out, still.

prompts.text: Both hands about 40 cm out, still|Palms toward you

switch.text: Both hands about 40 cm out, still|Backs toward you

sections.title: Near misses
sections.intro: Taps and pinches that stop just short. Bring thumb and finger about 1 cm apart without touching, or aim with a relaxed hand, so the tracker learns what isn't a click. Nothing happens when you do: the cameras record your hand.

prompts.text: Right hand pointing. Cyan: tap thumb to index. Orange with a cross: bring them about 1 cm apart|and stop there, without touching.
Left hand pointing. Cyan: tap. Orange with a cross: stop about 1 cm short.
Right hand raised and relaxed, pointing at the lit button, the thumb resting loosely by the finger.|Don't tap: just aim, as between clicks.

says.nogo: Aim at it, hand relaxed: no tap

prompts.text: Right hand. Quick taps: tap and open again straight away.|2: a double tap. Open the fingers clearly after each.
Right hand, reaching for the lit part. Cyan: pinch it. Orange: stop with thumb and index|about 1 cm apart, no pinch.
Left hand. Cyan: pinch it. Orange: stop about 1 cm short, no pinch.
Right hand pointing. Purple: middle tap, thumb to middle fingertip. Orange with a cross:|thumb and middle about 1 cm apart, no tap.
Both hands up and pointing. Each lit button says L or R: tap it with that hand,|or stop short where it's orange.
Your own pace. Orange: hover just short of the button. Cyan: tap it as often as you like.|Move the arm while you do: straight, bent, higher and lower.

says.nogo: Your own pace: hover just short of it
says.tap: Your own pace: tap it now and then
